name: tryweddingdress
description: Static frontend + Cloudflare Pages Functions backend for Try Wedding Dress

scripts.dev: wrangler pages dev frontend --compatibility-date=2025-04-01 --binding SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL --binding SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=$SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY --binding FASHN_API_KEY=$FASHN_API_KEY --binding YOOKASSA_SHOP_ID=$YOOKASSA_SHOP_ID --binding YOOKASSA_SECRET_KEY=$YOOKASSA_SECRET_KEY --r2 RESULTS_BUCKET=tryweddingdress-results
scripts.deploy: bash scripts/build-static-frontend.sh && wrangler pages deploy frontend --project-name=tryweddingdress --branch=initial-import --commit-dirty=true
